source.detail: The named investment arm, established 1988, of Zamil Group Holding — a family-owned industrial conglomerate dating to 1920. It runs two divisions, Public Equity and Private Equity, MENA-focused: a split book of listed and unlisted holdings is precisely the multi-asset problem we address. ⚠ No CEO or CIO specific to the investment arm is confirmed; the holding company's president is not necessarily the person running it. Evidence: https://www.linkedin.com/company/zamil-group-investments
